notes: The editor is now CodeMirror 6: syntax colours, line numbers and the suggestion popup can no longer drift out of line with the text you typed

'
wrap' works properly at last — the caret, selection and line numbers all stay correct on the extra visual rows
Suggestions can no longer wipe out a chunk of the diagram if you move the caret with the mouse while the list is open
New for free from the editor: find and replace (Ctrl+F), reliable undo / redo, bracket matching and multiple cursors
Accented, CJK and emoji input now behave: IME composition is no longer swallowed and deleting backwards over an emoji no longer splits it in half
Named documents in the browser: a diagram starts as Untitled and autosaves, the first Ctrl+S asks for a name, and both autosave and Ctrl+S keep writing to it from then on
New documents manager (the name chip in the toolbar, or Ctrl+O): create, open, rename, duplicate and delete your saved diagrams
Autosave is real now — until this release only Ctrl+S wrote anything, so closing the tab lost whatever came after it
'Import' loads a .mmd file as its own new document instead of overwriting the one you have open
Each tab remembers its own document, so you can edit two diagrams side by side; if another tab saves the same one you are warned and asked which version to keep instead of silently losing work
The diagram can no longer end up showing an older render than the code in the editor

'Reset defaults' now actually re-applies word wrap,
wrap and suggestions instead of only changing the buttons
Tab honours the 'insert spaces' setting and the configured tab size
Zoom speed can no longer be set to 0, which used to leave zooming permanently dead
Exporting to .mmd no longer risks the download being cancelled, and failed saves and unreadable files now tell you what happened
An empty comment token no longer strips indentation instead of commenting
Mermaid's strict security level is now set explicitly rather than relied on by default
